subject: Nutrition

questions.q: Which class of diabetes medication works by inhibiting the enzyme alpha-glucosidase, thereby delaying carbohydrate absorption?
questions.explain: Alpha-glucosidase inhibitors (like Acarbose) block the breakdown of starches in the intestine, slowing glucose absorption.
